subject: Experience needs: start/stop, frame stream, pinned demo scenario, manual trigger
body: For the Live screen I need: sensing.start(profile, onEvent) with stop(); a SignalFrame stream (or onFrame callback) for the live HR/RR chart; the gate state so I can show windows, refractory and sham; a manual trigger the app's I'm off button calls; and one pinned deterministic simulator scenario that drifts at about 20 s into Live for the demo. The strap stays opt-in with simulator fallback.
